basic_details.short_information: Bank of Baroda (BOB), Mumbai, Across India, has invited applications for 4 posts in 4 roles under Advt No. BOB/HRM/REC/ADVT/2026/18. The posts include SVP: Dy. Chief Technology Officer (Dy. CTO), VP: Head AI, DVP: Dy. Head Cloud CoE (Centre of Excellence), DVP: Dy. Head Platform Engineering. The online application is open from 28 October 2026 to 17 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for BOB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: OBC candidates in the creamy layer cannot claim OBC reservation or age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: BOB Job Description
content_sections.text: The detailed roles and responsibilities are appended to the official notification. However, Bank reserves the right to modify and/or include any of the KRA(s) for any of the positions from time to time. Only Candidates willing to serve anywhere in India, should apply. The place of posting will be at Mumbai, subject to the Bank's right to modify the location of posting as per its business requirement.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Remuneration will be offered based on candidate's qualifications, experience, overall suitability, last drawn salary and market benchmark. Engagement is for an initial period of 03 years, renewable/extended for 1 year each up to a total of 5 years maximum.

content_sections.heading: How Will BOB Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Application Scrutiny Psychometric Test or any other test Personal Interview Compensation negotiation Minimum qualifying marks in Personal Interview is 60% for General and EWS, and 55% for reserved categories.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Printout of valid Interview Call Letter Printout of online application form Proof of Date of Birth Photo Identity Proof Semester/Year wise Mark sheets and certificates Caste Certificate if applicable Work experience documents

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BOB Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Visit Bank's website www.bankofbaroda.bank.in under Career section -> Current Opportunities. Register online in the appropriate Online Application Format. Upload scanned photograph, signature, Bio-data and other required documents. Apply on or before 17 November 2026.
